content: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk is the official TypeScript SDK for MCP servers/clients; npm latest is 1.30.0 (published 2026-07-27). McpServer + registerTool() with Zod/Standard Schema validation is the standard pattern; StdioServerTransport is correct for Claude Desktop subprocess integration (vs HTTP/Streamable transport for remote servers). GitHub main branch references an in-progress v2 line but it is not yet the published npm latest.
